rows.title: PUBLIC OBSERVANCE OF MEETINGS Members of the City Council may attend this meeting via videoconference. Any closed session may be held via teleconference. The public can observe this meeting at the links provided below. Applicants and citizens wishing to participate have the option of attending each meeting or they may do so through the videoconference platform ZOOM, using this link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/84530222968 ***Public Testimony is Limited to 2 Minutes***
HELD IN COMMITTEE

Sponsor: Mayor Quinton Lucas Calling an election on August 4, 2026, for the purpose of submitting to the voters of Kansas City a question authorizing City to establish semiannual vacant property registration fees not to exceed $200.00 for chronically vacant nuisance property, $1,000.00 for vacant commercial property and $200.00 for vacant unimproved property; directing the City Clerk to notify the responsible election authorities on or before May 26, 2026; enacting the vacant property registration fees ordinance contingent upon voter approval; and recognizing this ordinance as having an accelerated effective date because it calls an election.)

Sponsor: Director of City Planning and Development Department Approving the petition to establish the Tiffany Springs Logistics Community Improvement District No. 1; establishing the Tiffany Springs Logistics Community Improvement District No. 1 generally bounded by Northwest 101st Terrace to the north; North Amity Avenue to the east; Northwest Old Tiffany Springs Road to the south; and North Congress Avenue to the west in Kansas City, Platte County, Missouri; requiring the annual submission of certain records; and directing the City Clerk to report the creation of the District to the Missouri Department of Economic Development and the Missouri State Auditor.

Sponsor: Director of City Planning and Development Department Approving a development plan on about 0.23 acres generally located at the northwest corner of 10th Street and Central Avenue in District DC-15 allowing for the creation of a 384 foot structure which will contain ground floor retail and a data center. (CD-CPC-2026-00074)

Sponsor: Mayor Pro Tem Ryana Parks-Shaw Authorizing the City Manager to negotiate an agreement to establish a housing development corporation; directing the City Manager to review the inventory of publicly-owned parcels and develop a plan to transfer city-owned parcels to external partners pursuant to an agreement.

Sponsor: Councilmember Kevin O’Neill RESOLUTION - Amending the Shoal Creek Valley Area Plan by amending the Proposed Land Use Plan and Map for an approximately 23.65-acre tract of land generally located at the southeast corner of N.E. 104th and N.E. Cookingham Drive by changing the recommended land use designation from "Residential Low Density" to "Mixed Use Neighborhood and delaying the effective date." (CD-CPC-2026-00146)
ADDITIONAL BUSINESS

The City Clerk`s Office now has equipment for the hearing impaired for use with every meeting. To check out the equipment please see the secretary for each committee. Be prepared to leave your Driver`s License or State issued Identification Card with the secretary and she will give you the equipment. Upon returning the equipment your license will be returned.
Adjournment

Sponsor: Director of Neighborhood Services Department Accepting and approving a $49,000.00 grant award from the Missouri Department of Conservation, through a cooperative agreement, to educate about native plants by providing training for City staff and the general public and increase the number of Missouri native plants within the Kansas City landscape by providing residents with vouchers and landscape consultations; estimating and appropriating $49,000.00 in Fund 2580; and recognizing this ordinance as having an accelerated effective date.

Sponsor: Director of City Planning and Development Department Rezoning an area of about 0.45 acres generally located at 3924 Montgall Avenue from Districts R-1.5 and R-2.5 to District B2-1 so that the property owner can seek approval of a special use permit to allow for the use of motor vehicle repair. (CD-CPC-2026-00125)

Sponsor: Director of City Planning and Development Department RESOLUTION - Approving an amendment to the Heart of the City Area Plan on about 0.45 acres generally located at 3924 Montgall Avenue by changing the recommended land use from mixed-use neighborhood and medium-density residential to mixed-use neighborhood. (CD-CPC-2026-00126)

Sponsor: Councilmember Melissa Robinson RESOLUTION - Expressing the City Council’s support of the Stay Covered KC community retention campaign and its work to help Kansas City MO HealthNet enrollees maintain their Medicaid coverage under Missouri’s new renewal and community engagement requirements.

Sponsor: Councilmember Eric Bunch RESOLUTION - Approving an amendment to Briarcliff/ Winnwood Area Plan by changing the recommended land use from institutional to residential high density, on about 6 acres in an area generally located on the south side of N.E. Englewood Road, between N. Highland Avenue on the east and N. Flora Avenue on the west. (CD-CPC-2025-00117)

Sponsor: Councilmember Eric Bunch Rezoning an area of approximately six acres generally located on the south side of N.E. Englewood Road, between N. Highland Avenue on the east and N. Flora Avenue on the west from District R-6 to District R-1.5 and approving a development plan in lieu of a special use permit pursuant to Section 88-517-09-D to allow for an 18-unit transitional group home that includes administrative and other support services. (CD-CPC-2026-00116 & CD-CPC-2026-00118)
RE-REFERRED

Sponsor: City Manager’s Office COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE Vacating the sidewalk right-of-way in proposed District MPD generally located within the area known as the Country Club Plaza; directing the City Clerk to record certain documents CD-ROW-2025-00037); appropriating $5,000.00 from the Unappropriated Fund Balance of the Development Services Fund (2210) for the purposes of public communication; and recognizing this ordinance as having an accelerated effective date. FINANCE COMMITTEE “Advance and Do Pass as a Committee Substitute” Held on Docket 10.8.2026

Sponsor: Councilmember Nathan Willett Rezoning an area of about 23.65 acres located at the southeast corner of N.E. 104th Street and N.E. Cookingham Drive from Districts B2-2 and R7.5 to District B2-2, approving a development plan to allow for the addition of a grocery store and delaying the effective date. (CD-CPC-2026-00145 and CD-CPC-2026-00147)

Sponsor: Director of City Planning and Development Department Rezoning an area of about 14 acres generally located at the southwest corner of Tiffany Springs Road and North Platte Purchase Drive from District MPD to District MPD and approving a major amendment to a development plan for the Twin Creeks Master Planned Development to allow for a grocery store with a fuel center. (CD-CPC-2026-00094)
